requirements.scope: Immutable local capability identity, schemas, risk, and explicit access metadata; broader package composition is not covered.
Exact local runtime lookup, ambiguity, input/output validation, and required per-call authorization are covered; transport behavior is not.
Album lookup and unit converter local input/output contracts are covered; future adapters and schema paths are not.
Required authorization port runs for each local invocation and fails closed; durable grants and identity integration are out of scope.
Stable failures cover local missing, ambiguous, invalid input/output, denied, and handler paths; surface-specific diagnostic integrations are not.
Owned source, browser proof, tests, and examples pass local checks; no real browser/host qualification is claimed.

examples.installSource: Fresh package tarball generated by this checkout; standalone lock and install.
examples.limitations: No Astro retrofit, browser registration, or sidecar.
